A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same meta-learning and diffusion-based weight-generation work, despite renaming Lt-Di to Mc-Di and extensive revision. The text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices support comparison; important equations and displays were checked visually.

before.justification: v1 reports original accuracy, latency, convergence, ablation, sensitivity, and architecture-comparison results in Section 4 and Appendix D.

after.justification: v3 reports original experimental results in Section 4 and Appendix F, including revised ablations and new Tiered-ImageNet and Meta-Dataset evaluations.

M1.justification: Beyond renaming, v1's Section 3.1 loss combines weighted trajectory objectives restricted to nearest segments. v3's Equation 3 and Algorithm 2 instead sample task/local-target pairs and optimize losses over full target prefixes, changing supervision and inner-loop organization. The stated inference recurrence also changes, although v3's appendix derivation uses a conflicting recurrence.

E1.justification: v3 adds Tiered-ImageNet few-shot evaluation and Meta-Dataset cross-dataset generalization. Appendix F.3 evaluates Traffic Sign, MSCOCO, MNIST, CIFAR-100, and CIFAR-10 after training on eight other datasets, substantially extending represented domains and transfer conditions. Existing transfer-learning, Omniglot/Mini-ImageNet, DomainNet, and GLUE coverage largely remains.

E2.justification: Table 2 adds D2NWG and removes REPTILE and Meta-Baseline; Table 3 also adds D2NWG. The main ablation removes LLO-VAE and adds OCD and Tw-Di comparisons. Lv-Di and Mv-Di are corresponding renamed vanilla variants. D2NWG is mentioned in v3's DomainNet prose but absent from Table 4, so participation there is not established.

E3.justification: The reported inner-loop learning rate changes from 0.05 to 0.005. Table 3 removes Omniglot and Mini-ImageNet 20-way configurations, retaining 5-way 1-shot and 5-shot evaluation. New protocols include Tiered-ImageNet's 351/97/160 class split and Meta-Dataset's eight-training/five-unseen-dataset design. The default three segments and 20 diffusion steps remain equivalent after matching notation.

E4.justification: Table 1 redesigns the component ablation around meta-learning, local-target assignment, and consistency. OCD isolates the contribution of meta-learning, while Tw-Di tests whether introducing local targets without consistency is harmful. Appendix F.3 adds cross-dataset generalization testing. SAM/augmentation, sensitivity, and architecture studies are retained or revised, rather than newly introduced merely by relocation.

E5.justification: Both versions state that experimental results report means and standard deviations over five independent experiments. Neither adds a different uncertainty-estimation procedure, confidence intervals, significance tests, or explicit seed information. Changed standard-deviation values and additional result rows do not change this reporting practice.

E6.justification: Tables 1-5 substantially revise accuracies, latencies, and rankings. For example, GHN3's transfer CIFAR-100 accuracy changes from 49.94% to 11.90%, and the proposed method's Mini-ImageNet 5-way 1-shot accuracy changes from 68.10% to 64.87%. Tiered-ImageNet and Meta-Dataset results are added, while 20-way few-shot entries disappear. These are revised reports under changed methods/settings, not established same-setting improvements.

T1.justification: The formal objective and stated recurrence underlying Theorem 1 are revised, and Appendix A develops recovery of the local-target sequence. Appendix B adds an explicit proof of the previously asserted vanilla-diffusion special case. Theorem 2's convergence bound and assumptions are essentially retained. Unlike v1, v3's stated sampler disagrees with the sampler used in its proof and diffusion preliminaries.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion redefine the central diffusion contribution as resolving local-global inconsistency, rather than primarily exploiting optimization trajectories. v3 newly foregrounds the claim that naive local-target assignment is harmful and that its theory and experiments establish consistency with global optima. The broader meta-learning, efficient weight-generation, and SAM contributions remain.

C2.justification: v3 adds local-global inconsistency as a mechanism explaining poor naive-target performance and distinguishes nominal loss complexity from practical computational efficiency. Section 5 introduces the fixed-Gaussian-start limitation and arbitrary-subtrajectory learning as future work, while dropping the explicit call for validation beyond vision and language. Pretraining-overhead and easy-task caveats remain in the experimental discussion.

D1.justification: v3 newly specifies three inner steps, 6000 training epochs, Adam's weight-preparation learning rate and early stopping, and more explicit denoiser/conditioning references. Hardware memory is corrected from 512 TB to 512 GB. The explicit code-release link in v1 is removed without replacement; this does not establish that the repository itself became unavailable.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion retains its meta-learning/weight-generation structure, with targeted additions including D2NWG, ProtoDiff, new benchmark and optimization references, and Flow Matching/GFlowNet literature for future work. v3 explicitly characterizes Meta-Diff as single-level optimization and positions existing diffusion methods as the k=1 special case. Rombach and SVCCA references are removed.

P1.justification: The title, method names, terminology, and indexing are revised throughout. The abstract, introduction, methodology, analysis, ablation discussion, and conclusion undergo substantial rewriting. Appendices are reorganized into separate proof, setup, additional-experiment, and related-work sections; the impact statement is removed, and the author list/order changes.

P2.justification: The predominantly two-column layout becomes largely single-column. The workflow diagram is redrawn, a local/global-consistency schematic is added, and analysis plots and appendix panels are reformatted. Tables gain colored performance-gap annotations, Table 3's dataset/configuration columns are rebuilt, a Meta-Dataset table is added, and the symbol table is removed.

improvement.justification: Broader evaluations, more diagnostic consistency ablations, and additional training details strengthen the paper. However, v3 introduces disagreement between its stated inference update and Appendix A's proof. It also assigns v1's unchanged LLO-VAE architecture scores to the differently defined Tw-Di in Tables 6-7 without explanation. These issues affect the core method and attribution of supporting evidence. The PDFs do not resolve whether they are documentation errors or reflect what was implemented and evaluated, preventing a reliable net-quality judgment.
